[25] AR: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهْ EN: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record

folded.id: if muhammad|had|made up about us some [false] sayings
folded.subject: if Muhammad
folded.object: made up about Us some [false] sayings

spans.text: [44] AR: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ EN: And if Muhammad had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
[31] AR: ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ EN: Then into Hellfire drive him.
[51] AR: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ EN: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.

folded.id: it|will|be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers
folded.subject: it
folded.object: be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers

spans.text: [50] AR: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ EN: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.

folded.id: make you|know|what is the inevitable reality?
folded.subject: make you

spans.text: [3] AR: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ EN: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
[27] AR: يَٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ EN: I wish my death had been the decisive one.
[37] AR: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَٰطِـُٔونَ EN: None will eat it except the sinners.

folded.id: nor|any|food except from the discharge of wounds
folded.subject: Nor
folded.object: food except from the discharge of wounds

spans.text: [36] AR: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍۢ EN: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
[30] AR: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ EN: [Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him.

folded.id: so he|will|be in a pleasant life -
folded.subject: So he

spans.text: [21] AR: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ EN: So he will be in a pleasant life -

folded.id: so there|is|not for him here this day any devoted friend
folded.subject: So there
folded.object: not for him here this Day any devoted friend

spans.text: [35] AR: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌۭ EN: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend

folded.id: so you|would|see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees
folded.subject: so you
folded.object: see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees

spans.text: [7] AR: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍۢ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًۭا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍۢ EN: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
[4] AR: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ EN: Thamud and 'Aad denied the Striking Calamity.
[16] AR: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاهِيَةٌۭ EN: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.
[20] AR: إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ EN: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."

folded.id: that we|might|make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it
folded.subject: That We
folded.object: make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it

spans.text: [12] AR: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةًۭ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌۭ وَٰعِيَةٌۭ EN: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.

folded.id: the earth|and|the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow -
folded.subject: the earth
folded.object: the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow -

spans.text: [14] AR: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ EN: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow -
[34] AR: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ EN: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
[16] AR: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاهِيَةٌۭ EN: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.
[13] AR: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ EN: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
[43] AR: تَنزِيلٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ EN: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
[10] AR: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةًۭ رَّابِيَةً EN: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
[52] AR: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ EN: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

folded.id: the qur'an|is|a reminder for the righteous
folded.subject: the Qur'an

spans.text: [48] AR: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌۭ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ EN: And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous.

folded.id: the qur'an|is|the word of a noble messenger
folded.subject: the Qur'an
folded.object: the word of a noble Messenger

spans.text: [40] AR: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ EN: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is the word of a noble Messenger.
[15] AR: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ EN: Then on that Day, the Resurrection will occur,
[42] AR: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ EN: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
[24] AR: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ EN: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."

folded.id: we|carried|your ancestors in the sailing ship
folded.subject: We
folded.object: your ancestors in the sailing ship

spans.text: [11] AR: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ EN: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship
[49] AR: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ EN: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.

folded.id: we|would|have seized him by the right hand
folded.subject: We
folded.object: have seized him by the right hand

spans.text: [45] AR: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ EN: We would have seized him by the right hand;
[46] AR: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ EN: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.
[2] AR: مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ EN: What is the Inevitable Reality?

folded.id: which allah|imposed|upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession
folded.subject: Which Allah
folded.object: upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession

spans.text: [7] AR: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍۢ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًۭا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍۢ EN: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
[32] AR: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍۢ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًۭا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ EN: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."

folded.id: wish i|had|not been given my record
folded.subject: wish I

spans.text: [25] AR: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهْ EN: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
[8] AR: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍۢ EN: Then do you see of them any remains?
[18] AR: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌۭ EN: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.
